task_description: Create JWT authentication middleware for an Express REST API that validates access tokens and protects private routes.
Implement role-based authorization in a Node.js Express application with Admin, Manager, and User roles.
Create user registration and login endpoints for a Node.js Express application, including credential validation, session or token issuance, authentication failures, and protected-route access.
Implement OAuth-based authentication for a Node.js web application using a third-party authentication provider.
Create an API authentication system that supports access tokens and refresh tokens with token expiration handling.
Create a Node.js REST API that connects to PostgreSQL using connection pooling and performs CRUD operations for users.
Create a Node.js application that connects to MongoDB and implements CRUD operations for a product collection.
Implement database migrations and schema management for a PostgreSQL-backed Node.js application.
Create a Node.js service using an ORM to manage users, roles, and relationships in PostgreSQL.
Create a Node.js PostgreSQL service that performs a multi-step transaction, commits when all database operations succeed, rolls back on failure, and handles connection errors safely.
Create an Express endpoint that accepts CSV file uploads, validates the file, parses its contents, and returns structured JSON.
Create a Node.js service that generates PDF reports from structured application data.
Create an Express endpoint for uploading images with file-type and file-size validation.
Create a Node.js service that reads and validates XML files and converts them into JSON objects.
Create an API endpoint that imports an Excel spreadsheet containing customer records and validates each row before processing.
Create a complete Express REST API for managing products with create, read, update, and delete operations.
Create a Node.js REST API with request validation, centralized error handling, and structured API responses.
Create a Node.js API that calls an external REST service, handles retries, timeouts, and failed requests.
Create a WebSocket-based real-time notification service using Node.js.
Create an Express API with API rate limiting, request validation, and API documentation.
Create a Node.js module for securely encrypting and decrypting sensitive application data.
Implement secure password hashing and password verification for a Node.js service, including salt handling and safe comparison of stored credentials.
Create middleware that sanitizes and validates incoming user input to reduce common injection attacks.
Create a Node.js implementation for signing and verifying cryptographic messages using public and private keys.
Create an Express security middleware configuration that protects an API against common web security threats.
Implement structured application logging in a Node.js Express API with log levels and timestamps.
Create request logging middleware that records HTTP requests, response status codes, and request durations.
Implement centralized error logging for a Node.js application and save application errors to rotating log files.
Implement Redis-based caching for frequently requested REST API responses, including cache lookup, cache population, and expiration.
Create a Node.js application-level in-memory caching layer with configurable time-to-live values, cache invalidation, and protection against stale entries.
